maddeler.e:
أستبحر (form X)
# أَسْتَبْحِرُ (ʔastabḥiru) /ʔas.tab.ħi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
# أَسْتَبْحِرَ (ʔastabḥira) /ʔas.tab.ħi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
# أَسْتَبْحِرْ (ʔastabḥir) /ʔas.tab.ħir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
